Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 120. Category: heroic. Heroic Features.

Choose one ki technique type from beam, balst, barrage
or omni. All techniques with that type have their Range
inxreased by 50%.
This feature came taken a second time, to either
increase the range of the chosen type by another 50% or
to choose another type of ki technique to gain the
benefit instead.
